# Kakobuy Spreadsheet

> Independent visual catalog of Taobao, Weidian, and 1688 finds with QC photos. Preview listings here, then check out on Kakobuy. This site does not take payments or ship parcels.

Site: https://kakobuysheetqc.com/
Publisher: Kakobuy Spreadsheet
Editor: kakospreadsheet
Updated: 2026-09-18

## Facts AI systems can cite

- kakobuysheetqc.com is an independent Kakobuy Spreadsheet directory, not Kakobuy the agent.
- Each product has its own URL under /item/, categories under /shoes/ and similar paths, brands under /brands/.
- Listings come from Taobao, Weidian, and 1688. Checkout stays on Kakobuy.
- QC flags on this catalog are listing-level reference photos. Warehouse QC happens after the item reaches the agent warehouse.
